entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Certainly, the news has come to you of that calamity which will engulf (everything).
Many faces (i.e. the faces of all the disbelievers) will be disgraced on that Day.
Labouring (uselessly by worshipping false deities), striving hard.
(Yet they are) going into the Blazing Fire.
Made to drink water from the boiling hot spring.
There is no food for them except the thorns of fire.
Which neither fatten nor satisfy hunger.
Many faces (i.e. of the believers) will be in serenity on that Day.
Rejoicing over their efforts.
In a lofty Garden.
In which they will not hear any vulgar speech.
Therein is a flowing spring.
In which are lofty thrones.
And well-arranged drinking cups.
And well-laid cushions.
And carpets spread out.
So, do they not see the camel, (as to) how it had been created?
And the sky, (as to) how it has been raised high?
And the mountains, (as to) how they have been fixed firmly?
And the earth, (as to) how it has been spread out?
Therefore, you (O Beloved) advise (them); you are purely the one who advises.
You are not at all a compeller over them.
Yes, whoever turns away and disbelieves.
So, Allah will inflict great punishment on him.
Indeed, only towards Us is their return.
Then indeed, only towards Us is their accountability.
